Name: Nari Anime Pixel Style Portrait
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[b][CP] Nari Anime Pixel Style Portrait[/b][b]Anime-Inspired Pixel Portrait Overhaul for Stardew Valley [/b]Elevate your Stardew Valley experience with [b][CP] Nari Anime Pixel Style Portrait[/b], a mod that reimagines your villagers in vibrant anime-style pixel art! Perfectly blending Stardew’s charm with detailed anime aesthetics, this mod offers a fresh take on character portraits that fans of both styles will adore.

[line][b]
Features[/b][list]
[*][b]Anime-Inspired Pixel Art[/b]: Stunning portraits that combine the expressive flair of anime with the retro charm of pixel art.
[*][b]Complete Villager Redesigns[/b]: All major characters receive a fresh new look, capturing their personalities in an anime-inspired style.
[*][b]Seasonal Themes and Expressions[/b]: Dynamic seasonal outfits and diverse emotional expressions add depth to your interactions.
[*][b]Content Patcher Compatibility[/b]: Fully designed for seamless integration using the Content Patcher framework.
[/list][line][b]Installation[/b][list=1]
[*][b]Install Required Mods[/b]:
Ensure you have [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b] installed. These are necessary to run this mod.
[*][b]Download and Replace[/b]:[list]
[*]Download the mod and extract the contents of the ZIP file.
[*]Replace the folder [code][CP] Nari[/code] from the ZIP file into your Stardew Valley [code]Mods/[CP] Nari[/code] directory.
[/list]
[*][b]Launch the Game[/b]:
Start Stardew Valley via SMAPI, and enjoy the updated anime-style portraits!

[/list][line][b]
Why Choose This Mod?[/b]This mod is perfect for players who love anime and pixel art, adding an extra layer of personality and visual appeal to the game. With regular updates planned, you can look forward to more features and refined details over time.

[line][b]
Credits[/b]Original mod created by [b]requeksm[/b], inspired by anime aesthetics and designed to integrate seamlessly into Stardew Valley. Thank you to the modding community for making these enhancements possible!
Enjoy the revamped look of your favorite villagers and bring a fresh visual style to your Stardew Valley adventures. Download today!

Downloads.Description: Anime-style pixel art portraits for Stardew Valley villagers. Requires the original mod by requeksm. Replace the [CP] Nari folder to update the portraits. Compatible with Content Patcher. Perfect for anime and pixel art fans!
